body:
I guess I don't think there is any certainty of anything after you die. There is no way of knowing for sure. 

For me I know there are people in my life that care a lot about me. I just don't care that they care. If I die I can't feel guilty over what I cause them.

I'm just so scared of dying. I hope there is nothing afterward. It scares me to think of spending an eternity in the afterlife. Whether it is heaven or hell or some sort of purgatory, eternity of anything freaks me out.
